newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices rise as arrivals drop.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices rise as arrivals drop.

text.p: Sugar prices rose on Tuesday following a drop in arrivals and aided by a fresh bout of consumer demand, dealers said.
"Demand for sugar picked up today after it remained subdued in the last two-three days because of violence in the city," said a dealer.

Violence rocked Bombay at the weekend following the death of 10 people in police firing on Friday during a protest over desecratrion of the staue of Bhimrao Ambedkar, India's revered leader of the lower castes.
"Arrivals of sugar still remained poor as several transport operators have not yet resumed services to Bombay after the riots," the dealer said.
In ready delivery, sugar S-30 rose 10/15 rupees to 1,480/1,500 rupees per quintal (100 kg) and M-30 by 10 rupees to 1,500/1,550 rupees per quintal. Sugar mill delivery was unquoted.
